title: People’s Mañanera June 22
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Well-Being Scholarships/Stipends: Education as a Right  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted that the Well-Being
Scholarships/Stipends benefit 12.8 million students nationwide. The Rita
Cetina Scholarship/Stipend is allocated to more than 8.2 million elementary
and middle school students, while the Benito Juárez Scholarship/Stipend
reaches 4.18 million upper secondary education students.

She also noted that the distribution of Rita Cetina Scholarship cards will
conclude on July 31 and that families will receive a one-time payment of 2,500
pesos (US$1444) for school uniforms and supplies.

**USMCA: Dialogue, Cooperation, and Strengthening the Regional Economy  
** The President reported that the meeting held in Washington to review
progress on the USMCA was “very good” and announced that Mexico will host a
new meeting in July to continue negotiations.

**The People’s Support: The Greatest Strength of the Transformation Project  
** After being recognized by Time magazine, Sheinbaum said that “as long as we
remain close to the people, there will continue to be popular support.” The
President explained that closeness to the people, honesty, results, and love
for the people and the nation are the foundation of the Fourth Transformation.

She also criticized the opposition’s classism, racism, and subservience,
arguing that those who prefer to speak ill of Mexico abroad rather than engage
with the population are distancing themselves from the people’s interests.

**Colombia: Respect for the Democratic Process  
** In relation to the presidential election in Colombia, Sheinbaum called for
prudence and respect for the electoral process.

“We will wait for the preliminary vote count to be completed, which may even
extend into the first few days of August; then we will wait to congratulate
whoever emerges victorious,” she said.

**Anti-Screwworm Strategy Is Strengthened  
** The President announced that the first phase of the sterile fly production
facility to combat the screwworm will be inaugurated this Friday in Chiapas.
She explained that production will increase gradually and that talks with the
United States are continuing to advance in the normalization of livestock
exports, noting that meat production grew over the past year.
